text: Commit from the UI: review the changed files and enter a commit message
description: Felix 2026-10-16: a commit dialog lists the uncommitted files (idea files shown by their idea text), lets the human pick which to include (all by default), takes a message and commits. Stage only the chosen paths, never blanket-stage: agents share the working tree.

status.comment: CommitModal from the header button: changed files with checkboxes (all on, code first, idea/phase files named by their text), message field, 'Commit N files'. Backend git.commit stages only the chosen paths and commits with --only, so others' staged changes stay staged (backend test on a temp repo, 3/3). Component spec 1/1, pnpm check 25/25; opened live, no commit made in the real repo.
